title: Study on Internet Medical Models for the Management of Patients With Hypertension in China
brief_summary: The study is a multi-center, randomized, open, and parallel study. Approximately 958 subjects will be enrolled in 16 sites. The random number table will be adopted to conduct cluster randomization per township hospital/community health service center. Patients will be randomized 1:1 to receive blood pressure management in Internet medical model or Conventional medical model. After follow-ups of 3 months and 6 months, the blood pressure in each group will be observed and compared.
